nora (People Ops): Quick mid-cycle note for managers: two small updates to the review logistics and one new pilot. Please skim. :eyes:

nora (People Ops): Dates recap: peer feedback due 2026-03-31; manager reviews due 2026-04-10 23:59 PDT; calibration meetings 2026-04-13 -> 2026-04-17. Final lock 2026-04-24.

nora (People Ops): Update A - Pair calibration pilot: were trialing 10-minute paired calibrations for small teams (2 managers together) to speed consensus. Calendar invites will mark "pair" or "group". If you prefer the standard 20m group, opt-out in the invite.

nora (People Ops): Update B - Form bug: some managers see a blank "calibration notes" field after saving. If that happens, re-open the form and paste notes into the comments box and DM me a screenshot. Were patching tonight.

igor (Eng Manager): Re pair pilot: will that change who needs to attend? My manager and I both have mixed schedules.

nora (People Ops): Pair pilot: only the two managers responsible for the same calibration pool need to attend. Director presence optional unless youre flagging a rating exception.

talia (Product Manager): Small ask: can we get a one-line reminder template to paste in peer asks? Ill send to my team.

nora (People Ops): Sure - use this: "Hi — quick favor: add 2-3 bullets about collaboration and impact for my review by 03/31. Appreciate an example if possible. Link: <intranet/reviews>"

maya (People Ops): Extension refresher: manager-level extensions up to 48h for documented PTO/medical; >48h or director signoff cases use the extension form and cc People Ops.

hr-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Peer feedback due in 7 days" will post to channel and DM all contributors on 2026-03-24 09:00 PDT.

nora (People Ops): Thanks all ping if you hit the form bug or need to opt-out of pair calibrations. :white_check_mark:
